brief:
Outgoing Israeli minister of heritage Amichai Eliyahu called Palestinians and Muslims "camel riders" and "barbarians" during a parliamentary speech on Monday, according to Middle East Eye. The remarks came as Eliyahu prepares to leave office.

The comments mark an escalation in inflammatory rhetoric directed at Palestinians and the broader Muslim world by an Israeli government official during his final days in the position.
